name: RTX 5090: Llama 3.3 70B Q4_K_M decode tokens/sec
methodology: llama.cpp CUDA backend, batch size 1, 512 token prompt, 128 token output, Q4_K_M quantization, 32GB VRAM
notes: RTX 5090 with 32GB GDDR7 at 1792 GB/s. A 70B model at Q4_K_M requires ~35GB of VRAM, which exceeds the 32GB capacity. This benchmark assumes some layers offloaded to CPU or a smaller context. With full GPU offload, a 70B model at Q4_K_M does not fit in 32GB. The RTX 5090 is best suited for models up to ~32B at Q4_K_M or ~16B at Q8_0.
